name: git_history
description: Human-labelled retrieval cases from this repository's real 2026-08/09 commit history. Commit IDs in metadata make each fact auditable; this is repository history, not a live agent answer test.

memories.title: Event-sourced memory governance
memories.content: The event log became the source of truth; recall familiarity was separated from externally checked confidence; personal and shared scopes were introduced.

memories.title: FibBrain runtime added
memories.content: FibBrain added plan, recall, coordinate, remember, observe, advise and reflect above the FibMind memory engine. The harness still runs the agent loop.

memories.title: Versioned event log contract
memories.content: The S0 change versioned the event log and pinned a cross-implementation conformance fixture for replay and tool behaviour.

memories.title: DSH session evaluation importer
memories.content: The S1 integration mounted FibBrain through dsh-mcp-client and added an importer that turns real DSH session logs into evaluation candidates requiring manual labels.

memories.title: Session episode review
memories.content: S2 persisted the episode and added deterministic, idempotent session review to extract long-term memory candidates.

memories.title: Procedural memory rendering
memories.content: S3 added procedural memory and rendering, so verified procedures can become agent skills or tool definitions.

memories.title: Why inverted BM25 stayed in memory
memories.content: S4 replaced full lexical scans with an inverted index and BM25. FTS5 was deferred because the in-memory index met the performance target and avoided separate SQLite and JSON indexes. Hashing hybrid increased irrelevant hits, so embeddings stayed off by default.

memories.title: Frozen L0 hot memory and token budgets
memories.content: S5 introduced a frozen per-session hot-memory snapshot and split a hard token budget across hot memory, direct search and graph expansion. The small fixed suite did not prove the 30 percent token saving target.

memories.title: Native DeepSeek-Harness plugin
memories.content: S6 added a Cordis plugin for step recall, pre-tool advice, result observation, turn-end review and procedure skills.

memories.title: Evidence-gated ranking tuning
memories.content: S7 proposed bounded ranking changes from confirmed and refuted memories and adopted them only if the fixed evaluation suite did not regress.

memories.title: CI quality gate
memories.content: The September 18 quality change added Ruff checks, Python 3.11 and 3.12 CI, Node plugin tests and an evaluation floor gate that fails on retrieval regressions.

memories.title: 可见性与事件回放模块拆分
memories.content: 九月十八日将身份可见性规则移到 visibility.py，将事件回放处理移到 replay.py，缩小 graph.py 的职责并保持公共 API 不变。
